title: Battle of Gettysburg
summary: The Battle of Gettysburg was fought on July 1–3, 1863, around the town of Gettysburg, Pennsylvania. It was a major battle of the Civil War. The recipients listed here are the people whose official citation entries place the action at Gettysburg. Period photographs survive; motion-picture footage of the battle does not.

media.note: Official battlefield site.

media.note: Feature film adapted from The Killer Angels. Commercial drama, not a documentary.

title: Belleau Wood
summary: Belleau Wood, northeast of Paris, was fought in June 1918 during the German offensive along the Marne. U.S. Army and Marine units fought in the woods and the nearby villages. This hub lists recipients whose citations name Belleau Wood, Bois de Belleau, or Bouresches.

media.note: Cemetery beside Belleau Wood.

media.note: History by Alan Axelrod, with an introduction by Bing West.

title: The Lost Battalion in the Argonne
summary: In early October 1918, units under Major Charles W. Whittlesey were cut off in the Argonne Forest near Charlevaux and Binarville. The pocket is remembered as the Lost Battalion. The recipients here are the soldiers and the two airmen whose citations name that pocket.

media.title: Lost Battalion (World War I)

media.note: Cemetery for the Meuse-Argonne offensive.

media.note: Television drama about the pocket. Not a documentary.

title: Battle of Iwo Jima
summary: U.S. Marines and Navy corpsmen assaulted Iwo Jima on February 19, 1945, and fighting continued until March 26. Standard compilations record 27 Medals of Honor for the battle. This hub lists recipients whose citation entries name Iwo Jima, Mount Suribachi, or the Volcano Islands in 1945.

title: Chosin Reservoir
summary: After Chinese forces entered the Korean War, United Nations troops fought around the Chosin Reservoir from late November into mid-December 1950. The 1st Marine Division and nearby Army units withdrew toward Hungnam through Hagaru-ri, Yudam-ni, and Koto-ri. This hub lists recipients whose citations name the reservoir or those villages.

title: Battle of Ia Drang
location: Ia Drang Valley, Pleiku Province, South Vietnam
summary: In November 1965 the 1st Cavalry Division (Airmobile) fought North Vietnamese Army units in the Ia Drang Valley. The best-known fighting was at Landing Zone X-Ray and Landing Zone Albany. This hub lists recipients whose citations name the valley or those landing zones.

title: Battle of Kamdesh
location: Combat Outpost Keating, Kamdesh, Nuristan Province, Afghanistan
summary: On October 3, 2009, Taliban fighters attacked Combat Outpost Keating near Kamdesh in Nuristan Province. The outpost was nearly overrun. Clinton L. Romesha and Ty M. Carter later received the Medal of Honor for actions that day.

title: Battle of Mogadishu
summary: On October 3, 1993, during a raid in Mogadishu, two U.S. Army helicopters were shot down. Master Sergeant Gary I. Gordon and Sergeant First Class Randall D. Shughart received the Medal of Honor, both posthumously, for defending the crew of the second crashed aircraft.

title: Second Battle of Fallujah
summary: The Second Battle of Fallujah was fought in November and December 2004, when U.S. and Iraqi forces assaulted the city. Staff Sergeant David G. Bellavia received the Medal of Honor for actions on November 10, 2004, during Operation Phantom Fury. A battle with one recipient uses the same page structure as a larger action.
